thread:
maria: Heads up — thinking through the console + API contract for automatic fallback toggles. Quick q: do we want per-route REST PATCH (/routes/:id/fallback) or a single GraphQL mutation for rollouts? Also need audit fields for operator overrides. Example sketch below:

maria: ```json
{
  "mode": "soft-degrade",
  "triggers": ["latency", "5xx"],
  "sample_rate": 0.05,
  "override_ttl_seconds": 3600,
  "reason": "safety net during model rollout"
}
```

jon: Leaning per-route. We tie quotas, model pinning, and routing at the route level — makes the surface smaller. GraphQL okay for batch updates but REST is simpler for ops buttons.

kevin: We also need to record before/after policy snapshots in the audit log + operator id and freeform reason. Console should show a diff.

sara: From SRE side — telemetry must include which signal triggered the fallback (latency spike, error rate, specific 5xx code). Those should be tags in the audit event so we can filter. Also please avoid logging request body (PII).

jon: Proposed minimal policy schema to iterate on:
```json
{
  "type": "fallback_policy",
  "mode": "soft-degrade" | "hard-switch",
  "trigger_signals": ["latency", "5xx"],
  "trigger_window_seconds": 60,
  "sample_rate": 0.05,
  "override_ttl_seconds": 3600,
  "decision_id": "string"  // surfaces in traces
}
```

kevin: Add `fallback_variant` id and `decision_id`. Decision id is critical — surfaces in API responses so product can attribute which policy caused the switch (useful for replay). Also add `audit_event_id`.

maria: Console UX notes: show active policies on the route page, last triggered time, last operator who tweaked it, and a small "simulate" button to run a dry-run for 5 minutes against live traffic (monitor-only). Need a monitor-only flag.

sara: Simulation must be sandboxed: dry-run traces, no mutations to KV cache, no real failover to cheaper model. Runtime needs a `dry_run` flag that only emits decision telemetry.

jon: Quick nit: for PATCH semantics — allow partial updates (PATCH) but validate contradictory fields (e.g., `sample_rate: 1` with `mode: soft-degrade` is fine but clarify semantics). Also require `reason` on operator override.

kevin: Telemetry wise, add sample caps to avoid alert storms: `max_samples_per_minute` and `min_signal_duration_seconds`. And strongly prefer structured reasons (enum) + optional freeform.

maria: I'll draft a short API doc + console wireframe. cc @kevin for `decision_id` naming convention and @sara for runtime dry-run constraints.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: applied fallback-schema change to staging at 1753332400 — run `./scripts/fallback-schema-check` and sanity smoke tests.

jon: sgtm. Also add an integration test to surface `decision_id` in sampled responses so we can link to traces.

kevin: I'll add proto and a small audit-log integration test.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll open the RFC and a small implementation PR after the wireframes. Thanks everyone.
